seo.title: Multiple Telegram Desktop Profiles on Windows
seo.description: Launch separate Telegram Desktop data folders with InstanceDeck. Community recipe; local account verification is pending.
seo.intro: InstanceDeck launches the installed Telegram Desktop executable with a separate data directory. The recipe uses app launch settings and leaves binaries untouched. Verify each visible account and data path before use.
